address: Avenida Atlântica 1702, Rio de Janeiro, 22021-001, Brazil
bio: (Temporarily closed for refurbishment) Part of the historic “Copa” (Copacabana Palace, A Belmond Hotel), the city’s most famous hotel thanks to its setting on what is considered by many to be the world’s most famous beach, the Ristorante Hotel Cipriani is a sophisticated space that combines the best of Italy and Brazil. Here, Italian chef Nello Cassese creates a single tasting menu entitled Essenza Dell'Evoluzione (choose between the full 14-course experience or a shorter 11-course option) that uses Italian ingredients that he expertly combines with others sourced more locally, in so doing giving classic Neapolitan and Piedmontese specialities (such as deep-fried pizza and “Mediterranean” tuna) a more contemporary feel alongside an array of other more creative dishes.
